payload.description: Browse every picture and video your Agents and apps have made, and keep the best ones. Gallery gathers the images and videos found across Leaf into one wall you can flip through. Like a picture with the heart or dislike it with the thumbs down, add tags and filter. A like or dislike belongs to the picture itself, so every Leaf app showing it (Ambience, Image Studio) sees the same one. It is not a photo editor and it does not delete anything.
